subject.title: fix(config): reject invalid heartbeat activeHours without cadence

question: Should OpenClaw fail config load for previously accepted malformed heartbeat `activeHours` values when `heartbeat.every` is omitted, or should this PR add an upgrade/doctor handling path first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct, but repository policy treats stricter config validation as upgrade-sensitive because an existing user's malformed config can stop loading after merge.

options.title: Accept fail-closed invalid times
options.body: Land the PR as-is and own the upgrade behavior because docs/types already require HH:MM and the resulting validation error is explicit.

options.title: Add upgrade diagnostic first
options.body: Require a doctor diagnostic or repair path for malformed heartbeat active-hours values before merging the stricter schema validation.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed invalid times
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is and own the upgrade behavior because docs/types already require HH:MM and the resulting validation error is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config/runtime schema history makes this the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
